objective: Prove, with a Lean kernel, which knots arise as the least-violation states of rules on pairs. Energies are sums of terms that each depend on at most two variables. Establish: on three variables a knot is a least set exactly when its two excluded states are opposite (four knots, the frustrated triangles); no knot on four or more variables is a least set; with hidden variables every knot is (the MAX-2-SAT gadget); the strict and competition readings agree whenever some state breaks no rule; and competition depends on the rules' weights, so the knot needs equal weights.
status: Proved by KNOT-COMPETITION-20261019-001A-P001: competing rules on pairs make exactly the four not-all-equal knots on three variables (the frustrated triangles) and no knot on four or more; with hidden variables every knot; the strict reading never gives a knot; the readings agree when some state breaks no rule. Lean 4.32.2 kernel and an independent exact checker.
title: Which knots competing pairwise rules can make
